subject: StegVerse commit-time admissibility, not the SDK's read-only diagnostic processor
purpose: StegVerse independently authored counterpart to Richard Whitney's MIR Experiment One. Four equally weighted capability, limitation and verification sections. A source implementation is not current authentic runtime proof.

questions.question: What was claimed?
questions.answer: Source defines a request-bound, current-admissibility boundary evaluated before a consequence-bearing transition. Actual source checks cannot grant ALLOW.

questions.question: What was independently observed?
questions.answer: The current original Experiment 3 resident admission and current authority decision have not been independently retrieved into this source-only document.

questions.question: What physical work occurred?
questions.answer: No independent MIR environment action or external physical consequence is proved by this source-only SDK diagnostic.

questions.question: What remains unknown?
questions.answer: Native original-request lease producer/current resident custody and independent MIR-side delivery, environmental coverage and shared blind spots remain independent verification targets.

sections.title: Observe
sections.capability: Current StegVerse source specifies attributable manifested ingress, native lease, actual InTr disposition and consequential transition receipts when an authorized runtime performs them.
sections.limitation: A manifest, source build, CI result or downstream receipt cannot independently observe MIR's uninstrumented environment, prove an event occurred or establish current resident deployment.
sections.verification: Submit one original bounded request through existing authenticated ingress. Independently read its actual InTr admission/refusal, current native lease and original organization ledger predecessor sequence. Record activity-side measurements separately.

sections.title: Demonstrate
sections.capability: The governing claim is a current commit-time admissibility decision against state, policy, execution scope, required evidence and unexpired, nonrevoked original authority. Source-level consumer implements fail-closed pre-execution checks and exact result binding.
sections.limitation: Historical approval and a source-only DENY are not the actual decision at commitment; an earlier valid lease can expire or be revoked. An SDK diagnostic's four PASS entries are documentation predicates, not four executed runtime capabilities.
sections.verification: At an authenticated existing runtime, demonstrate one genuinely authorized commitment and one refusal after original authority expires/revokes. Verify original request/wire and actual decision from independent same-transition Master Records, not fixture hashes.

sections.title: Retain
sections.capability: Canonical source defines exact, predecessor-linked organization transitions, required evidence digest binding and Master Records custody; the installed readback can inspect existing resident original records.
sections.limitation: Source availability does not prove the resident captured this experiment, durable retention after loss, independent outside custody or completeness of off-platform activity.
sections.verification: From the original authenticated organization HEAD enumerate the complete global predecessor chain, resolve every exact source record and verify matching Master Records RECORDED/PASS/PASS and required-evidence bytes.

sections.title: Reconstruct
sections.capability: Source requires each state-dependent successor to verify its immediate predecessor and matching custody; recorded refusal and ALLOW histories can be distinguished if original records exist.
sections.limitation: Reconstruction cannot infer unsubmitted activity, prove physical causation, equate a signed receipt to behavior or erase per-observer disagreements. The specific original Experiment 3 chain is not yet observed here.
sections.verification: Remove the submitting worker, replay the entire original global organization window including unrelated interleaved transitions, recompute original digests and compare independent before/after disposition and actual external observation.
